# Prisqo

> Prisqo is a one-time AI visibility check for local businesses: 6 buyer-style questions, one search-grounded AI model, and a report showing whether AI assistants recommend your business, who they name instead, and which sources they cite. One report costs $19, paid once, no subscription, no account.

## Key facts

- One AI visibility report: $19, paid once at checkout. No account, no subscription.
- Each check asks 6 buyer-style questions and records who AI recommends and which sources it cites.
- Prisqo does not query ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude or Grok directly; it uses one search-grounded model.
- A free 10-second check shows whether an AI search assistant named a business in a past check.
- A free one-page SEO audit is available on request.
